code:

ServiceNow                         Okta / Entra ID / Ping Identity
-- the app the user wants          -- confirms who the user is

SAML 2.0 is an open standard:
any SP trusts any IdP without custom integration per pairing.
caption: SAML is a real protocol, not a ServiceNow-specific feature.

code:
Holds the trust metadata:
  Entity ID            -- which IdP this is
  SSO endpoint URL      -- where to redirect the user
  Signing certificate   -- verifies assertions weren't tampered with

No record, no trust relationship.
caption: This record is the foundation the whole login flow depends on.

steps.label: Redirect
steps.sub: user hits ServiceNow, gets sent to the IdP's SSO endpoint

steps.label: Authenticate
steps.sub: password entered AT the IdP -- ServiceNow never sees it

steps.label: Assertion
steps.sub: IdP signs a confirmation; ServiceNow verifies it against the cert and logs the user in
